bifrost: render/src/glass.rs (glass effect) and render/src/gfx/ (renderer); no node-graph material editor
summary: A node-based material editor inside Reality Composer Pro that builds MaterialX materials for 3D RealityKit scenes. BifrOSt has a 2D desktop renderer and no 3D material authoring, so there is no counterpart.

features.apple: Shader Graph in Reality Composer Pro
Math, Logic, Data, Adjustment, Compositing, Organization

gaps: No 3D rendering or material authoring path; BifrOSt's renderer is 2D desktop compositing (render/src/gfx/, render/src/glass.rs)
